cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(SpecializedMemoryPublicTests LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
get_filename_component(COSTMODEL_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../costmodel" ABSOLUTE)
add_library(SpecializedMemory STATIC ${COSTMODEL_ROOT}/lib/AscendModel/RouteModel/SpecializedMemoryCostModel.cpp)
target_include_directories(SpecializedMemory PUBLIC ${COSTMODEL_ROOT}/include)
target_compile_options(SpecializedMemory PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -ffp-contract=off)
add_executable(SpecializedMemoryTests SpecializedMemoryTestMain.cpp)
target_link_libraries(SpecializedMemoryTests PRIVATE SpecializedMemory)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME SpecializedMemoryPublicTests COMMAND SpecializedMemoryTests)
